## Outcome and provenance
- [ ] Outcome and artifact are named; source path is linked.
- [ ] All owning source code, new media inputs, configs and dependencies are committed.
- [ ] Generated files are reproducible from the committed project; no ephemeral-only input.

## Evidence
- [ ] Exact build command and expected output documented.
- [ ] Applicable tests/build succeeded, with actual run link.
- [ ] Visual/interactive outputs were inspected in their intended form.
- [ ] Facts, caveats and approvals are correct.

## Delivery
- [ ] Pushed GitHub SHA and source link verified.
- [ ] Downloadable artifact URL or CI artifact linked.
- [ ] Remaining uncertainty explicitly listed.
